title: The pH scale
caption: pH runs from about 0 (strongly acidic) to 14 (strongly alkaline), with 7 neutral at 25 °C. Each step of 1 is a factor of 10 in [H⁺]: stomach acid at pH 1.5 has about 300 000 times the [H⁺] of blood at pH 7.4. Typical values.
alt: Bar chart of typical pH values from stomach acid 1.5 through pure water 7 to bleach 12.6.
description: Acidic: stomach acid 1.5, lemon juice 2.4, vinegar 2.9, coffee 5.0.
Alkaline: blood 7.4, seawater 8.1, baking soda solution 8.3, household ammonia 11.6, bleach 12.6.
